title: Structured beams: modes, a Bessel core and a zone-plate focus
summary: Hermite-Gauss and Laguerre-Gauss modes keep their beam quality (M² = 7 and 3, and 5, as the formulas say), an axicon makes a Bessel core whose first zero is at 197.7 µm against 197.1 µm analytic, and a 5-zone zone plate raises the fluence at its focus by 96 against (2N)² = 100.
